content:
Formula: Nash Equilibrium Condition
Exact Expression: u_i(s_i^*, \mathbf{s}_{-i}^*) \ge u_i(s_i, \mathbf{s}_{-i}^*) \quad \forall s_i \in S_i, \forall i
Definitions: Proposed solution concept of a non-cooperative game where no player has an incentive to deviate unilaterally from their chosen strategy.
Derivation/Reference: John Forbes Nash Jr., Equilibrium points in n-person games (PNAS, 1950); Kakutani fixed-point theorem proof
Example: Prisoner's Dilemma: (Defect, Defect) is the unique dominant strategy Nash Equilibrium
Domain: game_theory
Assumptions: Finite game with mixed strategy extensions; Players are rational payoff-maximizers with common knowledge of game rules
Common Errors: Assuming Nash equilibrium is always Pareto-optimal or socially efficient
subject: Nash Equilibrium Condition
